from: Three wordings of the Abs unlock and two of the pubic-hair unlock, all recorded, none chosen
to: THE DOCUMENT’S WORDING IS THE PHRASE. GIVE HER THE GRATER. GONNA NEED THE CARPET TO MATCH THE DRAPES
note:
SIX WORDS BACK AND BOTH LOCKS ARE EXACT: GO BY THE DOC, THOSE ARE THE PHRASES.

AND THE RULING DOES MORE THAN FIX SPELLING, BECAUSE THE PRONOUN WAS CARRYING A PERSON. GIVE HER THE GRATER PUTS A WIFE AT THE DESK ASKING FOR HER WOMAN. Give me the grater would have put the woman there asking for herself, and Torie’s in-scene claim would have made her the asker. The document does not name the speaker, so HER was the only word in the sentence that told you where to stand in the room. THE ARCHIVE HAD IT AS ME AND WOULD HAVE HAD THE WRONG WOMAN AT THE COUNTER.

AND THE CARPET IS SINGULAR, WHICH IS ALSO A POSTURE. GONNA NEED THE CARPET is somebody DECIDING. The carpets need to match is somebody OBSERVING A REQUIREMENT. Same information, different woman saying it.

WHY THIS CLASS OF TEXT GETS ASKED ABOUT INSTEAD OF TIDIED: a Secret Menu gate IS KNOWLEDGE OF THE EXACT WORDS. There is no approval step behind it. Marianne tried to replace SHOW ME THE BIGGER ASS BUTTON with MAXIMUM SUPPORTED WHOLE-CHEEK REALISATION and was overruled by every woman in the waiting room, which tells you what the Clinic thinks of improving these sentences. NORMALISING A PHRASE WOULD HAVE BEEN EDITING THE LOCK.

THE ARCHIVE’S MISHEARINGS ARE KEPT IN q-grater-wording rather than deleted, as the record of what it got wrong. AND THE STANDING RULE IS UNCHANGED BY THE ANSWER: a phrase is recorded so the system can RECOGNISE it, AND IS NEVER SURFACED TO A WOMAN WHO HAS NOT SAID ONE FIRST.
